content.rendered:
We made sure to save you a lot of time when creating a list of trustworthy AngularJS Bootstrap templates. Admins, dashboards, and other web apps are all possible with these.

These tools are at the top of their game, with a 100% fluid layout, lightweight structure, and well-organized code.

This means that no matter your choice, you unlock yourself to many options and possibilities. Some even come with landing pages, while others are exclusive dashboards.

What’s best is that you can preview all of them first, witness them in action (even on different devices), and then proceed from there.

Make the development process fun – with an AngularJS template!

Top-Notch AngularJS Bootstrap Templates

ArchitectUI


ArchitectUI is one of the more versatile dashboard templates available on the market. It includes nine main layouts, multiple other page layouts, and 100s of components.

You can also choose from numerous preset color skins, making finding the right one for your project much easier. All the elements are easy to improve and adjust, so you can create a dashboard panel that precisely meets your needs.

Documentation, friendly support and regular updates are part of the bundle.

Additionally, you can choose from three pricing options, starting with Freelancer for $69 (for one application only).

Download Preview

NobleUI


NobleUI is an AngularJS Bootstrap template that supplies you with multiple demo options. You have light, semi-dark/light, and dark themes and an optional horizontal navigation bar sample. NobleUI also does not miss an RTL template.

It also saves you extra time with functional applications, like email, chat, and calendar, to name a few. Extra internal pages from wizard (plus validation), easy style configuration, and lifetime free updates, all this and more is what you get with NobleUI.

Note: depending on the time of your purchase, you can even score a nice discount.

Download Preview

Spruha


The development of admins and dashboards happens much easier with an AngularJS Bootstrap template. Another of our favorites is Spruha. We are amazed that this tool doesn’t have 100s, heck, 1000s of downloads.

The kit comprises over one hundred HTML components, light and dark modes, RTL compatibility and file upload function. Don’t you think this is all you get. Not even close.

There’s so much more to Spruha that will make you want to use it immediately. You also have the freedom to customize default configurations lightly or heavily – that’s entirely up to you.

Download Preview

Minible


Minible continues to amaze us even with the Angular version. Yes, this template comes in various formats and technologies, truly covering everything.

But our focus is Angular, which is minimal and covers its wide range of layouts and elements.

Minible handles all types of web applications: eCommerce, CRM, CMS, admin panels, SaaS—you name it! You can even employ it for something custom.

You get all these functional apps, different charts, Sketch and Adobe XD files, six layout types and dark mode.

Start like a boss with Minible, no need for anything else.

Download Preview

Apzel


While some AngularJS Bootstrap templates come exclusively for admins and dashboards, others are for websites.

Apzel is a perfect example of a powerful bundle of goodies for app and software websites. The six home designs and multiple practical internal pages cover everything necessary to start immediately.

There’s even a shop and a blog section!

Other highlights are video support, a floating navbar, a back-to-top button, animations, and pricing. The layout smoothly reshapes to different screen sizes, ensuring great performance.

Apzel is also customizable and comes with a user/beginner-friendly code.

Download Preview

Landrick


Landrick is an all-around AngularJS Bootstrap template for building landing pages, hence the name. It has 100s of downloads and 5-star ratings, which makes it a tool worth checking out.

Landrick is getting all this shine because it ROCKS. It has a minimal design with over fifty pages that you can use, reuse, customize – whatever! – to your liking.

Along with multiple home designs, Landrick also comes with tons of extra inner pages—just in case. You can use Landrick for anything: software, applications, products, services, agencies, the list goes on and on.

Download Preview

MOPHY


MOPHY is a pretty exclusive AngularJS Bootstrap template since it comes for developing an admin dashboard for payments.

It has an extremely modern and mobile-first design that combines simplicity with creativity. Along with the main sample, you also get my wallet, invoice, profile, calendar and transition details sections.

MOPHY is in total harmony with all popular web browsers and devices. The user experience will always be first-class and that’s a guarantee.

Moreover, you can also access the professional support team for six months straight. However, MOPHY doesn’t miss extensive documentation either.

Download Preview

Syndron


Syndron is another more generic admin template based on Bootstrap 5 and AngularJS. It can be used for any application you plan to launch.

Even if working with out-of-the-box configurations, you can make great things happen. But the real fun begins when you modify it and improve it to meet your expectations.

Your work with Syndron will be easy, but it requires basic coding knowledge. Light and dark layouts, over sixty elements, two hundred icons, lazy loading, and Google Maps are some of the material that every Syndron gets.

Join the tribe and realize powerful web applications.

Download Preview

Kripton


As the name suggests, Kripton is an AngularJS Bootstrap template for the cryptocurrency industry. With its niche-specific designs, layouts, and features, you can comfortably kick-start your project immediately!

Kripton is very cheap for the amount of material you get. Over eighty pages, fifty elements, multiple dashboard styles, and dark mode are only a handful of the goodies you get.

There’s A TON MORE.

You can also choose from multiple present-color skins, pick a sidebar format, and create an RTL admin. Kripton has no boundaries, so approach it with an open mind and do your thing effortlessly.

Download Preview
